newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: SOCCER-THE 2,000TH COPA GOAL THAT WASN'T.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-THE 2,000TH COPA GOAL THAT WASN'T.

text.p: Confusion reigned in the Copa America on Thursday over the number of goals that have been scored in the history of the tournament.
Julio Cesar Baldivieso's goal for Bolivia in their 1-0 win over Uruguay on Wednesday was widely reported as being the 2,000th since the competition was first held in 1916.
But on Thursday Jorge Barraza, spokesman for the South American Football Confederation (CSF), said Balidivieso's goal had been the 1,999th.
"The total before the start of the Copa was 1,962 and there have been 37 goals scored in this tournament," he said. "It is a shame because Baldivieso's goal was superb."

"Ironically, the 2000th goal will probably be scored by a Central American player," he added, pointing out that the next game was Thursday evening's group C clash between Mexico and Costa Rica in Santa Cruz.
The Copa America is organised by the CSF but since 1993 two teams from the neighbouring CONCACAF region, representing North and Central America and the Caribbean, have been invited to take part.
